title: Bound on encoded list length
statement: Let $L$ be a finite list of finite bit strings, and let $c$ be a natural number such that every word $w$ in $L$ has length at most $c$. The concatenation of the self-delimiting encodings of each word paired with the empty word has length at most $|L|(2c+2)$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of finite bit strings
Every word in $L$ has length at most $c$
